validity.recommendation: Keep as-is; this is MGS-3 Package 16 (Jeddah cluster, 52 km gas trunk, EPC Tekfen). Optionally add OtherEnglishNames='MGS-3 Package 16 / Jeddah Area Pipeline' and treat StartYear=2028 as a project-level estimate pending a Jeddah-package-specific schedule.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — confirmed real. Two fully independent sources describe exactly this entity. (1) MEED 'Aramco selects contractors for Master Gas System expansion' states verbatim: 'Laying a 52km pipeline to serve customers in the Jeddah area' as Package 16, carved out for separate tender from the 16-package MGS-3 award. (2) Gulf Fire / BNC Project Intelligence ('EPC Contract Secured for 52-Kilometer Pipeline Network in Jeddah') reports Tekfen Constructions & Installations was awarded the EPC for 'Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 3, Package 16 ... 52-kilometer pipeline within the Jeddah cluster' — bylined BNC NETWORK, sourced from BNC Project Intelligence, NOT from GEM (verified independent origin). (3) DMS Projects separately lists a distinct project 'Saudi Aramco - Master Gas System Expansion - Phase 3 - Package 16 - Jeddah Area Pipeline.' Three independent traces, none GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION — correct: it is a Master Gas System (dry natural gas) transmission trunk; MGS-3 is explicitly a natural-gas transport network expansion (MEED, Aramco, Gulf Fire all say 'natural gas' / 'Master Gas System'). Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are right; no NGL/gathering/feeder mischaracterization. DUPLICATE — checked against all 65 Saudi gas rows and all ~20 MGS III rows: P6736 (52 km, 'Jeddah') is the unique Package 16; no other MGS III ProjectID carries the 52 km length or a Jeddah label (other MGS III rows are 28/83/116/150/170/185/190/192/196/212/310/458/462/470 km), so it is a distinct package, not a relabel or segment double-count. ATTRIBUTION — Owner Aramco 100% confirmed (MEED, Gulf Fire, Aramco all attribute MGS-3 / Package 16 to Saudi Aramco). Province is blank; sources place it in the Jeddah cluster (Makkah Province, western Saudi Arabia) but none state the province verbatim, so leaving province blank is defensible. Endpoints unknown — none of the independent sources give start/end nodes (only 'serve customers in the Jeddah area'), so blank endpoints are honest. SPEC — Length 52 km is corroborated by 2+ independent sources (MEED 'a 52km pipeline', Gulf Fire/BNC '52-kilometer pipeline'); HIGH. Diameter blank — no source states a Package 16 diameter (the diameter list in the wiki spans the whole MGS-3 program, not this package); leave blank. Capacity blank — no package-level capacity published; leave blank. Status=construction is reasonable: MGS-3 construction began Q2 2024 with completion targeted Q4 2028, and Package 16 was retendered (technical bids due 30 May 2024) then awarded to Tekfen; defensible as construction. CAVEAT: StartYear1=2028 is the MGS-3 program-wide completion target (Q4 2028 per MEED/Aramco), applied to this package; it is a project-level estimate, not a Jeddah-package-specific commissioning date — flagged but not overturned. Net: real, correctly classified, not a duplicate; spec values present (length) are corroborated HIGH; remaining blanks (diameter/capacity/endpoints) are genuinely unpublished and left blank rather than fabricated.

summary: P6736 confirmed real and correctly classified: MGS-3 Package 16, a 52 km Jeddah-area Aramco gas transmission trunk (EPC Tekfen); length/fuel/type/owner corroborated by 2+ independent sources (MEED, Gulf Fire/BNC, DMS); unique vs roster (no duplicate); caveat only that StartYear 2028 is a program-level target and diameter/capacity/endpoints/province are unpublished and left blank.
